universities.summary: Sri Ramachandra Institute of Higher Education and Research (SRIHER) is a deemed university at Porur, Chennai. Its health-sciences campus brings medical, rehabilitation, allied-health, life-science and related degrees together. This portfolio covers 98 verified regular routes, with exact qualifying conditions, separate domestic and overseas fee categories, and programme-specific selection.
universities.campusLifestyle: The current prospectus describes a 150-acre Porur campus with teaching hospitals, laboratories, a central library, sports facilities and student clubs. Accommodation, banking and other daily services are on campus. Confirm access, residential allocation and any programme-specific arrangements before joining.
universities.cityProfile: SRIHER is based at No.1 Ramachandra Nagar, Porur, Chennai 600116. The university’s medical, rehabilitation, allied-health and other listed programmes use this campus setting. Travel, clinical schedules and accommodation choices should be planned for the actual faculty and reporting venue stated in the offer; the university name should not be used for a similarly named independent college.
universities.practicalExposure: The current prospectuses describe academic study alongside applicable laboratory, clinical, field and research work. Medical admission uses the prescribed national counselling route; rehabilitation and allied-health programmes retain their exact qualifying degrees and internships. The B.Sc.(Hons.)Allied Health Sciences technologies are allocated after second-semester examination by rank, so they are not separate first-entry programmes. Curriculum participation does not itself establish professional registration or overseas licensing.
universities.hostelOverview: The current prospectuses describe separate hostels and residential services. Room categories, mess, deposits and insurance or other compulsory charges have separate schedules. Medical fees expressly exclude hostel charges. Confirm the accommodation offer, room availability, required payments and withdrawal/refund conditions before acceptance.
universities.dietarySupport: Campus mess and food services are described separately from tuition. Confirm meal options, medical diets, allergies and personal food requirements with the residential office before choosing accommodation; a general campus provision is not a guaranteed specialist menu.
universities.safetyOverview: Obtain the current university student grievance, anti-ragging, emergency and medical-support contacts before joining. Programme admission may include medical-fitness and original-record checks; no particular safety outcome or emergency response time is promised.
universities.studentSupport: University selection and MCC reporting use different processes. Keep the exact qualifying certificates, result/allotment records and applicable registration, internship, experience or equivalence documents ready. Confirm accessibility and programme-specific academic support before acceptance.
whyChoose: A Porur campus combining medical, rehabilitation, allied-health and academic science study.
Exact programme records distinguish school-entry, graduate-entry and medical-residency routes.
Native fee quotes retain their own applicant category and annual or whole-course basis.
thingsToConsider: National medical counselling differs from university entrance or merit/interview selection.
Some allied-health technologies are allotted after admission rather than selected independently.
Overseas full-course prices must not be divided into invented annual tuition.
An academic programme listing does not guarantee professional registration or overseas practice.
bestFitFor: Applicants matching the exact school-subject or qualifying-degree requirements.
Medical graduates satisfying current NEET-PG, registration, internship and counselling conditions.
Applicants who will compare the correct award, campus, category and complete charge schedule.
recognitionBadges: UGC — Deemed to be University under Section3

faq.question: Which programmes are covered?
faq.answer: The portfolio includes 98 regular routes across medicine, rehabilitation, allied health, life sciences, psychology, public health and related fields. Each programme retains its exact qualifying route; undergraduate, postgraduate and medical-specialty admission conditions differ.

faq.question: How do medical applicants enter?
faq.answer: MBBS uses the applicable NEET-UG and MCC route. MD/MS requires the recognised medical degree, registration, prescribed internship, NEET-PG qualification and MCC allotment. The university checks originals, category and fitness before admission.

faq.question: Are all allied-health technologies selected at entry?
faq.answer: No. The current B.Sc.(Hons.)Allied Health Sciences prospectus says its technologies are allotted after the second-semester university examination based on rank. They are listed as options within one degree, not separate first-entry offerings.

faq.question: What do rehabilitation master’s applicants need?
faq.answer: The current MPT route requires a recognised BPT with 50%marks. The MOT route requires the stated regular on-campus BOT qualification with 50%marks. Exact programme, internship, recognition/equivalence and selection conditions still apply.

faq.question: Does the programme confer a professional licence?
faq.answer: An academic listing is not a professional-registration or practice-licence guarantee. The university’s NCAHP-labelled prospectus establishes curriculum and admission information; it is not presented here as independent council approval. Check the applicable profession and intended jurisdiction separately.

faq.question: What language is used?
faq.answer: The six preserved routes retain their previously verified programme language details. Other current routes leave teaching language unspecified where it is not established by the checked prospectus. Confirm classroom, examination and clinical communication arrangements.

faq.question: When do programmes begin?
faq.answer: Use the applicable university or counselling notice for current registration, selection and reporting dates. No unconfirmed first-entry month is assigned to the new routes, and an old orientation or reporting date is not treated as a future intake.

faq.question: What fee category is displayed?
faq.answer: New medical tuition figures use the stated domestic/general category. Other native programme-charge quotes retain their exact annual basis. The six preserved overseas routes keep their own FN/NRI category and full-course USD tuition; these prices are not interchangeable.

faq.question: Why are some annual tuition values on request?
faq.answer: A published whole-course total or a general programme-charge figure does not establish isolated annual tuition. The exact native amount is quoted separately with its proper category and basis; it is not divided or relabelled to fill another field.

faq.question: Are hostel and other charges included?
faq.answer: Housing, mess, deposits, registration, insurance and other charges have separate conditions and schedules. Medical annual tuition excludes hostel charges. Confirm the complete personal payment schedule and refund terms before paying.

faq.question: Are the original overseas programmes still available here?
faq.answer: The six existing programme records retain their exact awards, slugs, durations and audience restrictions. Their published full-course USD tuition amounts are preserved without invented annual averages. A current offer still depends on the programme’s own category and qualifying conditions.

faq.question: Is MScClinicalPsychology the same as a professional clinical qualification?
faq.answer: The preserved M.Sc.ClinicalPsychology is an academic programme and is not represented as an RCI clinical-psychologist licence. A separately named professional qualification has its own entry and approval requirements; similar names do not make the awards interchangeable.

faq.question: Where is the university located?
faq.answer: SRIHER is at Porur, Chennai, with the listed faculties in its university campus setting. Use the exact faculty and reporting address on the offer for clinical schedules, travel and housing rather than a similarly named institution.
